# Add a page type the crawl did not read

Pages behind a login, after a form, or past the crawl's page limit have no class yet. Make one like
the generated ones, so tests use it the same way:

1. A package `pages/<name>/` (lower case, e.g. `pages/orderconfirmation/`) with:
   - `<Name>Page.java` extending `LoadablePage<<Name>Page>` and implementing the
     interfaces of the doors it needs (ReadableAction and VerifiableAction always). Copy HomePage's
     structure: `TITLE` (or none), `open()` if a URL reaches
     it, and an `isLoaded()` that checks the URL, the page load, the title and one or two key
     elements, throwing an Error that names what was not ready.
   - `<Name>Elements.java`, and `actions/` with a class per door it needs (read and verify always;
     click, enter, check, and `<Name>Tasks.java` for a form, when it has something for them).
2. Its path in UrlPaths' **paths** YOURS block, if it has one.
3. The action that leads there (`submit()` on the form's page) returns `new <Name>Page(page).get()`.

Files you create are yours: regenerating never touches them. If the page belongs in every future
crawl (it just wasn't reached), tell the user: a new crawl with a higher `--max-pages` may generate it.
